input: Find outdoor adventure, nature, farm, horseback riding and sports summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Tryon, Columbus, Saluda, Lake Lure, Chimney Rock, Rutherfordton and Forest City, NC, and Landrum, SC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Tryon Columbus Saluda summer camp 2026 horses nature kids

candidates.name: Foothills Equestrian Nature Center (FENCE)
candidates.note: 2026 camps for ages 5–12 included equestrian nature, environmental, nature/art and general activity camps; equestrian nature camp does not include riding.

candidates.name: The Adventure School
candidates.note: 2026 outdoor camps for ages 3–16, including canoe and multi-adventure expeditions.

candidates.name: Miller Eventing
candidates.note: Multi-day riding camp at FENCE covering dressage, cross-country and stadium jumping; 2026 camp held and 2027 announced.

candidates.name: Clear View Farm
candidates.note: Summer riding and IEA camps emphasize horsemanship and showmanship; horses, equipment, lunch and snacks provided.

candidates.name: Landrum High School Baseball
candidates.note: Offers a 2026 youth baseball camp with camp registration and medical-release forms.

candidates.name: Kids Camp Landrum
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp at First Baptist Landrum with games, themed activities, crafts, field trips and daily devotions.

candidates.name: YMCA of Greater Spartanburg — Polk County YMCA
candidates.note: 2026 summer day camp, sports camps and swimming lessons; day camp serves ages 5–12, with counselor-in-training programming for ages 13–15.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Polk County 4-H
candidates.note: 2025 Summer Sparks offered supervised summer workshops for ages 5–18; no prior 4-H membership required.

candidates.name: Rumbling Bald on Lake Lure
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Adventure Camp included nature exploration, swimming, tubing, team games, crafts and field trips.

candidates.name: Camp Lurecrest Ministries
candidates.note: Christian residential youth camp with outdoor recreation, sports and horseback riding; summer 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Lake Lure Classical Academy
candidates.note: School athletics page lists Summer Youth Sports Camps at its Raptor Center; session dates and ages are not specified.

candidates.name: Piedmont Council, Scouting America — Camp Bud Schiele
candidates.note: Scout residential summer camp; Cub Scout resident camp ran June 28–July 1, 2026, and Scouts BSA registration is open for 2027.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Rutherford County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Fun enrichment camps offered educational workshops, tours and hands-on activities for ages 5–18.

candidates.name: KidSenses Children's Interactive Museum
candidates.note: 2025 day camps included Animal Adventures and Fossil Discoverers.

candidates.name: Town of Forest City Parks & Recreation
candidates.note: Summer offerings include volleyball, golf, basketball and tennis camps, plus two-week morning or evening swimming lessons.

candidates.name: Cleveland County YMCA — Rutherford County Family Programs
candidates.note: Rutherford County youth summer camps meet at The R.O.C., 140 Old Caroleen Road.
